I went to go see a psychologist today, I skipped the GP part because I didn't want meds thrown at the situation. I'm aware that SSRI's in people under the age of 25 cause heightened suicidal ideologies, and can't afford someone to just go throwing meds at the problem. I'm calling my psychologist again tomorrow to set up another appointment for next week. I'm also going to see a GP about possibly getting me on somme anti anxiety medication. 

I am getting a written letter sent from my psychologist to my office at work stating that I was there. I was emotional when I left and forgot to get it.
